notes.title: Small update - Keybind option update!
notes.content:
Howdy fellow miners! 

With the community's popular demand, we have introduced the quality of life improvement to Cave Digger 2. 

Whether you want to dig with your keyboard, joystick, or potatoes connected to a wire, now you can change the keybinds of the game however you like! 

Just go to the menu, options and on the bottom right list there should be an option called Keybindings where you will be able to change the key scheme and remind you of the controls if you have been off for some time. 

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336771/8db0b050e427914aad057f43707700448fc49613.png

We are constantly updating the game and trying to make improvements, so keep a lookout for more updates to come! 

Thank you everyone, and keep on digging on!

notes.title: Second Patch Incoming!
notes.content:
Hello Miners! We have updated some patch for you today! 


 Fix aim assist not aiming at all objects
 Made mining animations faster
 Added adaptive triggers for PS5 gamepad
 Added haptics for all platform gamepads
 Added more visible help text for Q pickup
 Added a resolution dropdown for PC/Mac


We keep improving and updating the game regularly, so come to our discord to give us some feedback! 
We also have Dev streaming every Saturday if you want to play multiplayer with the devs ːsteamhappyː
Remember to dig harder everyday, and join our discord for recommendations and bug reports! discord.gg/cavedigger

notes.title: v2.0 hotfix!
notes.content:
Improved pickaxe mining speed and reach
 Added aim assist option
 Added controller smoothing
 Added help texts for tools
 Fixed some UI bugs and improved usability

notes.title: To All the new Rookie Miners!
notes.content:
Welcome to Cave Digger 2, New Miners! 

We hope you're enjoying the Steam Next Fest and the demo of our game! 

If you are, please don't forget to wishlist us, it helps a TON! 

If you have encountered any bugs, trouble, or just want to talk to the devs, visit our OFFICIAL CAVE DIGGER discord and make sure to say hi in the SALOON! 

Discord.gg/cavedigger


You can also report bugs using in-game report system. 

We have a very friendly and active community, alongside weekly multiplayer session with the devs, so don't hesitate to join in and say hello! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336771/0e8f6308350f9ad9a5a459191b083af00a9429b4.jpg

Control Scheme for CD2 Flat

Move: 	WASD
Jump:	Space bar
Menu:	TAB
Use tool at hand:	Left Click
Throw:	Right Click
Special action:	R
Crouch: 	C 
Equip/ replace tools:	1, 2, 3, 4
Use / Take Loot:	E
Rotate Crank:	W/S
Sprint:	Left Shift
Pick up comic, clue, or map:	Q

Tools abilities

GoldPan:	Throw at enemies to bounce it off, Cpt A style (Must be upgraded)
Hammer:	Rocket Booster (Must be upgraded) 
Shovel:	Chain Shovel, can be attached to walls for faster and vertical movement (Must be upgraded)
Detektor:	Can detect loots and see through walls for mapping
Dynamite:	Bigger boom the more you upgrade
Pistol:	Auto reload and higher damage 
Pickaxe: 	Can mine higher level walls
